Hello Eng. *{name}*, 👋

This is a reminder that you have a session for group *{group_code}* scheduled tomorrow at *{time}*. 📅

Please make sure to join at least 15 minutes before the session starts to avoid assigning another trainer to the session.

Thank you,
eyouth Coordination

Hello Eng. *{name}*, 🚨 

Your session for group *{group_code}* at *{time}* will begin shortly.

Please confirm that you are ready to start.

• If you notice students are not focused or refusing to turn on their cameras, please inform me.
• If there is any inappropriate behavior or disturbance from any student, please contact me immediately.
• Please note that only 2 breaks are allowed during the session — no more and no less.
• During breaks, please share a visible timer on screen.

Thank you,
eyouth Coordination
